title: Event-store idempotency fixtures contaminate shared integration state
notes: Cluster B from the final integration run: 14 failures involving TC-ISS-203-01..05, TC-ES-03-01, TC-EE-08-04, TC-EE-10-04/05/06, TC-ISS-202-01, and TC-EXT-01-INT-07. Deterministic IDs reuse rows and trigger PostgreSQL 23505 on uq_event_idempotency; cleanup then fails on foreign-key references. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 6798-8490 and 8717-13212.
root_cause: Initial hypothesis: integration fixtures reuse deterministic event and idempotency identifiers across cases or binaries sharing one database, while cleanup is incomplete or ordered before dependent rows are removed.
candidate_resolution: Generate per-test UUIDs/idempotency keys, isolate each fixture transaction or namespace, and make cleanup delete dependents before event-store rows while remaining unconditional after failures.

commits_applied.summary: Replaced deterministic-seed UUID generation with TestHarness.newUuid() in event-store fixtures and added T011 to tools/lint_test_isolation.py.
Recorded Step 5 verification evidence showing build and unit checks passed while integration verification was blocked by cross-test connection termination.

verification_pending.note: ISS-0113 integration verification is deferred until the pre-existing test isolation BLOCKER is fixed: killIdleConnections() in tests/integration/helpers.zig:322 terminates all idle connections in the shared bpm_test database, including connections owned by concurrent test binaries.
verification_pending.required_follow_up: Fix GitHub #414, then rerun WF03-gh376-20260804 Step 5 integration verification before resolving ISS-0113.

prevention: T011 in tools/lint_test_isolation.py flags deterministic-seed UUID fixture helpers and calls.
Use TestHarness.newUuid() for event IDs and idempotency keys in shared-database integration tests.
